prior_exposure: All104 exposed first-min(600s,duration) recordings informed design; T2 mechanistic pilots and prefix-selector failures are explicitly exploratory. V4 T3 continuation outcomes were previously exposed but their samples are excluded from V5 development. Fresh ranks13-15 and next T3 continuation blocks have not informed algorithm or policy design.
target: Unchanged unit cursor-to-target direction proxy, within-block20ms valid-go pairs; no outcome-driven quality exclusions.

candidate_grid.order: family then head in listed order; no participant-ID-specific routing

normalization.query: First30 observed seconds, before any requested labels. Fixed for all adaptive and fixed-history fits; counts floor.1, power floor.01, clip z to[-8,8].
normalization.history: Entire strictly earlier permitted recording, capped600s.
normalization.daily_controls: All features available by end of matched calibration: first150s for daily120 and first270s for daily240. These stronger controls may use more contemporaneous unlabeled observations.

history.selection: Same participant and channel layout, strictly smaller post-implant day, last3 by(day,sessionID) BEFORE label-availability checks. All come from fixed104-case development; no fresh case, same-day case, or query session admitted. No replacement for insufficient history.
history.training: Equal-session mean Gram/RHS with ridge1 and free intercept; first62 observations of each acquisition block burned; valid-go rows at fixed session-global stride5. Minimum50 rows per history; empty history gives zero prior.
history.quality_probes: For each selected prior family, evaluate its prior0 in each selected historical session as a chronological pseudoquery. Each probe uses only that older session's strictly earlier histories and first30s unlabeled normalizer, scoring[272,600). Only probes with>=50 score rows and at least one valid history count. Retain last3 identities before availability checks. Query-session outcomes never enter reliability. Report all probe identities, errors and exclusions.

prospective_calibration.label_intervals: If zero-label reuse is rejected, collect labels prospectively on[30,30+b); decision times60,90,150,270. Never request labels from warmup or retroactively before a label request.
prospective_calibration.validation: At each b fit on[30,30+b/2), validate[30+b/2+2,30+b). No labels from the2s gap enter validation or its training fit. Labels from the entire requested interval may enter final refit after stopping. Burn62bins per acquisition block in both sets; all normalizers remain fixedfirst30.
prospective_calibration.geometry: Both train and validation need>=100 valid burned rows and>=4 of8 angular sectors each containing>=10rows. Validation needs>=3 nonoverlapping2s groups with>=25valid rows each. Group boundaries are fixed by validation start, do not span acquisition boundaries; incomplete groups are not admitted. Directional validation counts and pooled losses use only the rows in retained groups.
prospective_calibration.quality: Coordinate-mean squared error (zero prediction approximately.5). Candidate must beat both zero and training-label-mean predictors in pooled validation by policy margin, and beat both in>=2/3 eligible2s groups. Choose smallest pooled validation MSE among passing six, fixed candidate-order tie. Return a full-requested-prefix refit. At240s without passing candidate abstain with zero output; never force a history fallback.
prospective_calibration.shortages: Keep requested and actually available elapsed label seconds separately, valid labeled rows, coverage and every stage failure. A stage not fully observed cannot pass. Short sessions and no-go windows remain in policy cost inventory; never substitute fresh cases. If a requested checkpoint is unavailable, abstain at the end of the observed recording and retain the full requested budget as cost.

policies.zero_label_gate: At least2 eligible chronological prior0 probes, mean error<=configured ceiling and worst<=.50; valid30s warmup and usable current prior required. Pick qualifying prior family with lowest mean error, fixed family-order tie. No current target labels consumed.
policies.limitations: Feature-only/history-based routing cannot identify arbitrary new target-map changes. Its negative-transfer rate and accepted coverage are measured, not assumed safe.

source_selection.cases: All104 development sessions, strict per-query chronology; unavailable common-window outcomes kept with null scores and all requested calibration cost retained.
source_selection.outer_exclusion: For each target person, exclude that entire person from policy ranking. Equal eligible-session accuracy within source person then equal source people. Cost averages all requested cases within each source person. Policies are fixed threshold rules, not learned risk models.
source_selection.ranking: Among policies whose equal-person mean R2 is at least daily120 mean minus.03, select lowest mean requested label seconds, then highest R2, then grid order. If none qualifies, maximize R2 minus.05*(mean requested label seconds/240), grid-order ties.
source_selection.assessment_lock: Commit all selected policy configurations and independently verified source evidence before assessment; no post-assessment retuning.

assessment.history_controls: Fixed tx45_sbp,tau.2,no baseline,first30 normalizer,history ridge1 and prior-centered gamma10. history30 uses prospective labels[30,60); history0 uses none.
assessment.daily_controls: Fixed tx45_sbp,tau.2,no baseline,daily ridge1 free intercept,labels[30,150)/[30,270),normalization first150/270. Fewer50 labels yields zero with explicit fallback.
assessment.new_sessions: Identical[272,600) score window for every method and stopping time;>=50valid rows required. All24 requested archive ranks retained; no replacement.
assessment.t3_blocks: Separate negative-control domain: all validgo rows from nexttwo unusedwholeblocks afterV4 selections. Eight requested sessions, seven available by metadata, one no-block disposition. Only original known[30,270)prefix labels may calibrate; noV4tail labels or intermediate continuation labels enter fits, reliability or decisions.
assessment.aggregation: Equal-session mean within each of8 new-session people, equal-person cohort mean. T3 separately equal-session; no pooling. Abstention produces zero predictions and stays in all-case accuracy; accepted-only coverage and negative-accepted counts separately reported.
assessment.metrics: Variance-weightedR2, coordinateR2, MSE, angular error with zero assigned90degrees, labelcost, rowcounts, action/coverage, paired contrasts with identical masks.

uncertainty.T3_and_T2_unit: session; descriptive small-sample within-person intervals, not independent-person inference

gates.reduced_calibration_noninferiority: Requiresadaptive_useful;pairedadaptive-daily120R2 lower>-0.05;equal-person mean requested label seconds<=90. Descriptive engineering gate, not powered clinical inference.
gates.T2_recovered: All3 requested sessions scored;adaptive meanR2>=.05;>=2positive accepted sessions;gainoverzero>=.05;pairedgainoverhistory0 bootstrap lower>0. Abstention alone cannot pass recovery.

execution: Pin source hashes and data identities. Export/reload exact numeric model before feature-only replay. Policy receives only history diagnostics and lazy requested-prefix evidence; scorer targets and counterfactual controls cannot enter decisions. Retain failed attempts/exposure state; independently reconstruct fits, decisions, chronology, scores, costs and intervals. Publish aggregate allowlist only; raw arrays/models/sample traces remain local.
runtime: Measure exact adaptive export from first new-session participant/rank (T2 rank13), even if abstained. Three fast and two60s paced20ms feature-ready streaming replays, plus observed calibration-decision fit cost. Same frozenV4numeric streamingcore; report filter response separately. No localRust builds.
